SEBI Approves Reforms Widening Investment Avenues and FPI Access

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) board has approved several reforms aimed at widening investment avenues and increasing Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) access. These reforms include allowing portfolio managers to invest in overseas stocks and overhauling portfolio management services. The changes are intended to broaden investment options and enhance FPI participation in the Indian market.
